description: Measured characteristics of the demo gsplat archives, read from each archive's own fitting/ stamps by scripts/gen_zenodo_records.py --refresh. Committed so the record text does not require holding the archives, which are hosted on Zenodo rather than in this repository. measured_sha256 records WHICH archive bytes refresh read; --check reports any non-null digest that no longer matches the manifest pin. A null digest means the figures were recovered from the stated source rather than archive bytes; a later pinned archive read may supply the digest while retaining those source-derived figures. quality_note is internal provenance; quality_caveat qualifies a published quality figure or explains an absent one to --check. unmeasured_reason records why refresh deliberately withheld measurements.

gsplats_3d_drosophila_gastrulation/droso.quality_note: REFIT 2026-08-26 from DrosophilaHistone.zarr.zip [data] tp150 — the 500-TIMEPOINT recording the demo documents. A first attempt used Dme_E1_His2AvRFP_..._corrected (1507 timepoints, same spatial grid), whose tp150 is a post-gastrulation embryo; every automated check passed on it and only visual inspection caught the wrong stage. Source is now asserted by timepoint count before the fit runs. Figures are the ARCHIVE measured with `gsplat compare` (41.65 / 37.07), not the fit-time stamp (41.76 / 37.15) — they agree to 0.1 dB here because `--preset standard` leaves little to cull (55,977 of 256,000). At the API default of n_iters=1000 the same fit culled 98,349 and the stamp overstated the archive by 9.7 dB, so a stamp is only trustworthy on a trained fit. 200,023 splats against the previously shipped 200,155 indicates the original also ran standard; the demo previously documented 39.89 dB, so this is marginally better.

gsplats_celegans/celegans_s1.gsplats.zar.quality_note: Measured 2026-09-01 from the HOSTED bytes with the generator's own _read_archive -- the same code path the records are built from, so the sidecar and the table agree by construction rather than by transcription. The download was md5-verified against the deposition and its sha256 matches the manifest's pinned digest for the copy the record serves, which is recorded in measured_sha256. This is NOT the unpinned local copy: that one is the older in-repo generation and its figures differ (local celegans stamps 53.49 dB with no foreground figure; local nexrad carries no stamp at all), which is exactly why reading it would have published a wrong number and why the earlier all-null state was correct at the time. Figures are the RANGE of the per-frame stamps, not frame 0: frame 0 is not representative. Frame 0 alone is 38.53 / 37.99, near the TOP of the 29.48-39.77 / 21.79-38.15 spread, so quoting it as the figure overstated foreground quality by up to 16 dB. The earlier per-timepoint measurement against the preprocessed volumes (global 35.57/30.03/19.65/21.11 and foreground 30.17/13.12/9.52/8.51 at t0/t100/t200/t300) stays unpublished: Otsu drifts 13.3x over the recording, so its "foreground" is a moving region. PRIOR PROVENANCE, KEPT VERBATIM because this field is never rendered so retaining both costs nothing, and the review pass was right that replacing it destroyed measurements: the absolute Otsu range (0.0135 -> 0.1795), the fixed MAX_SPLATS explanation for the real decline, and the zebrafish fixed-component recipe (voxels inside 6-connected components of >= 27 voxels in the raw frame) that is the recorded route to a stable mask. >>> DELIBERATELY ABSENT, not unmeasured. Measured 2026-08-25 per timepoint against the *_preprocessed.npy volumes the fit consumed (global PSNR 35.57/30.03/19.65/21.11 dB and foreground 30.17/13.12/9.52/8.51 dB at t0/t100/t200/t300), and the foreground figures are NOT publishable: Otsu drifts 13.3x over the recording (0.0135 -> 0.1795), so 'foreground' is a different region at every timepoint. At t0 the low threshold admits 26.4% of a nearly-empty one-cell embryo, inflating that end, so the apparent trend mixes real quality loss with threshold drift. Real quality DOES fall across the recording -- MAX_SPLATS is a fixed 22,000 per timepoint while the embryo goes from one cell to hundreds of nuclei -- but a stable mask is needed to say by how much. Template: the zebrafish demo's fixed component-based definition (voxels inside 6-connected components of >= 27 voxels in the raw frame), which does not move with image content.
gsplats_celegans/celegans_s1.gsplats.zar.quality_caveat: Figures are the archive's own fit-time stamps, given as the RANGE over its 400 per-frame stores. They are not reproducible by re-scoring the shipped bytes: the fit consumed preprocessed volumes, so a post-hoc figure against the raw source would score the preprocessing as well as the fit. The spread is real and expected -- a fixed per-frame splat budget covers an embryo growing from one cell to hundreds of nuclei, so later frames reconstruct less well. A separate per-frame measurement against the preprocessed volumes is deliberately not published, because the Otsu threshold drifts 13.3x over the recording, which makes "foreground" a different region at every timepoint.

gsplats_cell_tracking/6bba_09961292.gspl.quality_note: Source grid declared from the manifest acquisition shape (100 x 64 x 256 x 256 uint16), not read from archive stamps. Quality figures measured 2026-09-01 against the crop's own source timepoints (100x64x256x256 uint16, Kaggle CTC cache), per timepoint over frames 0/25/50/75/99 — the neuromast convention; foreground fraction is the median over the sampled frames. The archive is TRANSFORMED relative to the fit (recentre + 95th-percentile scale filter + per-timepoint amplitude renormalisation), so it was NOT scored on trust: a control arm scored the replayed-filter fit DIRECTLY (same splat set, no 4D stack, no marginalisation) and agreed to 0.017 dB at every frame. The replayed filter also reproduced the shipped per-timepoint splat count EXACTLY (41,129 at t=0), confirming the inversion. Centers are in micrometres (the fit used voxel_size=1.625 x 0.40625 x 0.40625 um), so a diag(1/voxel) transform maps them to render_to_volume's index space; the all-zero floor was 16.55-18.27 dB against measured 24.7-26.5, so the comparison is live. The shipped store carries no image_min, so each frame borrowed its own fit's floor (same data, same basis).
gsplats_cell_tracking/6bba_09961292.gspl.quality_caveat: Figures are for the STACKED ARCHIVE as served, measured per timepoint over frames 0/25/50/75/99. Whole-volume scores sit about 13 dB below the underlying fit (24.7–26.5 versus 37.9–39.6), while foreground scores sit about 23 dB below it (18.3–20.2 versus 41.3–43.1). The underlying fit scores higher in foreground than whole-volume, but the stacked archive scores lower, because stacking deliberately drops the largest 5% of splats by scale: under volumetric blending that diffuse tail renders as opaque discs that bury the nuclei beneath it, so the archive trades reconstruction fidelity for a legible render.

gsplats_flylight_mcfo_63x/flylight_mcfo_.quality_note: Measured 2026-08-26 at fit time on the 5000-iteration refit, against the fit's own composite volume on the voxel grid BEFORE any spatial transform. That is the only point at which this archive can be scored: its shipped form has been rotated, scaled and centred, and an attempt to invert that recovered a render correlation of 0.17. MSE 0.0894406, SSIM 0.9984, foreground over 0.07% of voxels at Otsu > 26.67; the basis is shifted by image_min=1 from the dataset so scores are background-relative and match the render. The 1000-iteration build it replaces scored 60.13 / 36.00 dB, so the gain is +2.90 dB foreground. Splat count rose 653,759 -> 660,035 (1.010x) while the stored size FELL 8,150,095 -> 7,650,636 bytes. Colour verified after writing: 660,035 RGB triples present, 97.2% of lit splats at full peak, confirming colour carries hue only. Exposure was settled by rendering both builds through the demo at a fixed camera: amplitude sum moved -1.4%, rendered total light -2.1%, mean foreground -1.4%, and p99 -0.7%; the -7.5% median-lit-pixel change is confined to faint neuropil. The existing 2.723 display window therefore remains appropriate for this build.

gsplats_nexrad_supercell/nexrad_supercel.quality_caveat: Figures are the archive's own fit-time stamps, given as the RANGE over its 82 per-frame stores. They are not reproducible by re-scoring the shipped bytes: the splats are authored in kilometres while the reference is a radar voxel grid, and raw reflectivity carries a no-data fill, so a post-hoc comparison would measure the regridding rather than the fit. The compression ratio is against the regridded voxel volume the fit consumed, which is why the acquisition line separately declines a ratio against the stored polar scans.

gsplats_zebrafish/zebrafish_4d.gsplats.z.quality_note: Source geometry DERIVED 2026-09-01 from the manifest acquisition line ("151 timepoints of 44 x 512 x 512 uint8, every one of which is fitted"): 151 x 44 x 512 x 512 x 1 B = 1,741,684,736, matching the acquisition's own stored_bytes exactly because this uint8 store is uncompressed. NOT read from archive stamps -- reading the pinned hosted bytes on 2026-09-01 confirmed the archive carries no source_shape and no quality stamps, which is why its PSNR stays absent. Supplies the compression ratio only.

h2afva/253tp/h2afva_253tp.gsplats.zarr.z.quality_note: PSNR ABSENT, and not honestly recoverable from the published archive. The splat count is the sum of the pinned store's finest per-part levels. The fit predates quality stamping, and the shipped splats use an isotropic grid while the source h2afva/fused volume is anisotropic, so post-hoc comparison would score the resampling as well as the fit. A refit against the source is the only honest route to global and foreground PSNR. The published 51-frame variant is the demo's every-fifth-frame slice of this same 253-timepoint fit. Source geometry DERIVED 2026-09-01, not read: the pinned archive retains no source_shape (verified 2026-08-28), so no download can supply it. Basis is h2afva/fused = (253, 407, 2048, 2048) uint16, cross-checked against the h2afva_decimation entries which independently commit the same per-timepoint [407, 2048, 2048] uint16 = 3,414,163,456 B; 253 x that = 863,783,354,368 B. Supplies the compression ratio ONLY -- PSNR stays absent and still needs a refit.

h2afva/51tp/h2afva_51tp.gsplats.zarr.zip.quality_note: PSNR ABSENT, and not obtainable from this archive. Verified 2026-08-28 by reading the pinned store: fitting/ exists but contains only a timestamp, while pipeline/ records recipe 'stream', lod_n_lods 12, and cutpoints ending at 121,163,285; neither group carries fit-time quality stamps or a recorded source_shape to score against. The archive is one 4D leaf with a twelve-step progressive ladder (121,163,285 splats; format 3.4), not a partition with per-tile detail levels. It does not retain source_archive, source_stride, source_timepoints, or stacked_axis_renumbered; its every-fifth-frame provenance comes from the generation history and demo contract rather than embedded lineage attributes. Obtaining a PSNR therefore means refitting the full 253-timepoint timelapse (a 9.25 GB batch-fit) so the figure is stamped at fit time, which is the only honest route for an archive whose fit reference is no longer identifiable. Scoring the shipped bytes post-hoc is not a substitute: the splats use an isotropic grid while the source volume's own grid is anisotropic, so a straight comparison measures the resampling rather than the fit. Source geometry DERIVED 2026-09-01, not read (same reason as the 253tp parent). Every FIFTH frame of the 253-timepoint recording, so ceil(253/5) = 51 frames of [407, 2048, 2048] uint16 = 174,122,336,256 B. Supplies the compression ratio ONLY -- PSNR stays absent and still needs a refit.

gsplats_4d_drosophila_embryogenesis/dros.quality_caveat: No reconstruction quality was recorded at fit time for this timelapse, and the published archive carries no stamps to recover one from -- verified by reading the hosted bytes rather than inferred. An honest figure needs either a refit that stamps quality as it fits, or a scoring run against the full 500-timepoint source recording, which is 77 GB of raw voxels and is not redistributed here. The compression ratio is against that raw voxel total and is exact.
gsplats_4d_drosophila_embryogenesis/dros.quality_note: Created 2026-09-01. Archive metadata READ from the HOSTED bytes with _read_archive after md5-verifying the download against the deposition (2f03fe31) and sha256-matching the manifest pin (11d3e2d9, 863,811,020 B): 83,221,420 splats, 4D, format 3.4, a 14-step progressive ladder. The read SETTLES the PSNR question rather than leaving it open -- the archive carries no fit-time stamps at all. A first download attempt was TRUNCATED at 146,800,640 B and was caught only by checking the size against the deposition, so the verify-then-parse order matters here. Source geometry is DERIVED from the manifest acquisition line (500 x 108 x 1352 x 532 uint16): 500 x 108 x 1352 x 532 x 2 B = 77,680,512,000, the RAW voxel total the compression column uses; the acquisition line's stored_bytes (19,333,771,628) is the source's COMPRESSED size, a different quantity. The single-timepoint sibling droso_gastrulation scores 41.65 / 37.07 on tp150 of the same recording, but that is a different archive from a different fit and is not quotable for this one.
